Nationalized on January 1, 1949
Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) established under Section 45ZB of RBI Act
6 members (3 RBI, 3 Government of India appointees); Governor has casting vote

Article 279A establishes Goods and Services Tax Council headed by Union Finance Minister
States have 2/3rd voting weight, Centre has 1/3rd voting weight in GST Council

Energy pyramid is ALWAYS upright (unidirectional flow)

topics.titleHindi: आधुनिक आवर्त सारणी एवं मोजले का आवर्त नियम

18 vertical columns (groups) and 7 horizontal rows (periods)
Elements in the same group have identical valence electron configurations

Baking Soda: Sodium hydrogen carbonate NaHCO3; Washing Soda: Na2CO3·10H2O
Plaster of Paris: Calcium sulphate hemihydrate CaSO4·0.5H2O
